text.es: Marta: Sé que eres una mujer independiente, no has dejado de demostrarlo desde que has llegado de Argentina. Fina: ¿Y qué pasa? ¿Que eso te molesta? Marta: No, me da rabia que no pienses en las dos.
text.en: Marta: I know you're an independent woman. You haven't stopped proving it since you got back from Argentina. Fina: And so? Does that bother you? Marta: No, it makes me angry that you don't think about the two of us.
